original_content_full:
DigiPolis presented at 9th KuI in Berlin

The paper "DigiPolis - An Approach for Interactive 3D Building & Interior Models as Communication Tools" by Joachim Quantz, Jürgen Döllner, Rolf Fricke, Robert Tolksdorf, Thomas Hoppe, and Ingolf Jung is presented at the 9th Kultur and Informatik conference on Multimedia Systems, which takes place in the Pergamon Museum in Berlin on 12/13 May, 2011.

Link: DigiPolis project webpage.
